results.title: Claudio Descalzi-led Italian energy giant Eni hands investors $1.5 billion special dividend as West African oil projects lift production by 7% - Business Insider Africa
results.snippet: * Eni will pay shareholders a special dividend of approximately $1.46 billion (€1.3 billion) in December. * Its share-buyback programme has also been increased to about $4.47 billion (€3.8 billion). * Third-quarter adjusted net profit more than doubled to approximately $3.3 billion (€2.8 billion). * West African project ramp-ups helped raise production by 7% to 1.83 million barrels of oil equivale
